project_info.name: KeuanganMasjid - System Management Keuangan Masjid Modern
project_info.theme: Elegan Islamic Modern (Emerald Green & Gold Accents)

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-50
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider

layout_and_navigation.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar with Emerald Deep background (#043927), Islamic star pattern overlay, Gold active indicators, collapsing state on mobile
layout_and_navigation.header: Top bar with Mosque selector, Date in Gregorian & Hijri (e.g., 14 Muharram 1448 H), Quick Infaq button (Gold CTA), Profile & Role Switcher
layout_and_navigation.grid: Bento Grid Mode B for financial cards with 4 key metrics, tight 16px gaps, consistent border-radius (rounded-xl)
layout_and_navigation.friday_special_theme: Laporan Mingguan Jumat page has a special golden header badge, Islamic geometric border accent, and print-ready layout

components_and_features.name: Dashboard Utama
elements: Card Saldo Kas Utama, Pemasukan Bulan Ini, Pengeluaran Bulan Ini, Saldo Infaq Jumat
Pie Chart (Breakdown Kategori Pemasukan/Pengeluaran)
Bar Chart (Perbandingan Pemasukan vs Pengeluaran per Bulan)
Line Chart (Tren Saldo Kas 12 Bulan)
Tabel 5 Transaksi Terakhir with Quick Action Modals

components_and_features.name: Laporan Mingguan (Khusus Hari Jumat)
elements: Friday Date Picker (Pilih Tanggal Jumat)
Header Bulletin Board style: Nama Masjid, Tanggal Hijriah & Masehi
Ringkasan Kas Kotak Infaq Jumat & Transfer
Daftar Penceramah/Khatib & Imam Jumat Minggu Ini
Grafik Komparasi Kotak Infaq 4 Jumat Terakhir
Tombol Cetak PDF Laporan Jumat DKM

components_and_features.name: Manajemen Transaksi
elements: Filter Tipe (Semua, Pemasukan, Pengeluaran)
Filter Kategori (Zakat, Infaq, Operasional, Renovasi, dll)
Pencarian & Selector Rentang Tanggal
Modal Tambah Transaksi (Form IDR auto-format, Kategori, Donatur, Catatan, Bukti Transfer)
Tabel Transaksi dengan badge pemasukan/pengeluaran & pagination

components_and_features.name: Manajemen Kategori
elements: Kartu Kategori Pemasukan & Pengeluaran
Warna Badge Kategori & Alokasi Anggaran
Modal Tambah/Edit Kategori

components_and_features.name: Donatur & Jamaah
elements: Daftar Donatur Tetap & Hamba Allah
Riwayat Kontribusi per Donatur
Badges Donatur Loyal / Donatur Qurban / Donatur Yatim

components_and_features.name: Program & Kegiatan Masjid
elements: Kartu Program (misal: Renovasi Kubah, Santunan Yatim, Buka Puasa Sunnah)
Target Dana vs Dana Terkumpul Progress Bar (% Gold indicator)
Daftar Donatur Terikat Program

components_and_features.name: Laporan Bulanan & Tahunan
elements: Export Excel & PDF feature
Format tanda tangan Ketua DKM & Bendahara Masjid
Breakdown Laporan per Akun Kas

components_and_features.name: Autentikasi & Peran User
elements: Switch Role: Admin DKM vs Bendahara Masjid
Form Login dengan visual Islamic geometric pattern

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.test_id_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, inputs, links, and cards MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.currency_rule: Format all monetary numbers using Indonesian Rupiah format: 'Rp ' + amount.toLocaleString('id-ID')
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.chart_library: Use Recharts for PieChart, BarChart, and LineChart with emerald (#065F46), gold (#D4AF37), teal (#0D9488), and amber (#F59E0B) colors.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.toast_notifications: Use sonner toast for success/error feedback (e.g., 'Transaksi berhasil ditambahkan').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.ui_components: Use Shadcn components (.jsx files in src/components/ui) customized with Emerald Green & Gold accent borders.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.accessibility: Ensure high contrast between emerald background and gold/white text.
